mission_10: Magnificent! You have implemented a complete GAN for data augmentation, representing the pinnacle of synthetic data generation techniques. The adversarial training process between generator and discriminator creates a powerful system that learns the true underlying data distribution. Your generator can now produce unlimited realistic samples that capture the statistical properties of the original dataset. GAN-based augmentation is particularly transformative in domains with limited data availability, such as medical imaging, rare event detection, and privacy-sensitive applications. While training GANs requires careful tuning and monitoring, the quality of generated samples far exceeds simpler augmentation methods. This completes your data augmentation mastery, from basic transforms to cutting-edge generative models!
